formulas.headline_quantity: current closed cash / (scheduled bid OPEN + recorded entry bar spread * 0.01)
formulas.headline_pnl: quantity * (exit bid OPEN - entry ask proxy)
formulas.financing_sensitivity: headline PnL + quantity * (-1863.7) * 0.01 * assumed charge count, then next weekend resized from resulting cash
formulas.gross_counterfactual: independent cash-funded account: quantity=current balance / entry bid OPEN, PnL=quantity*(exit bid OPEN-entry bid OPEN)
formulas.closed_drawdown: peak-to-trough of starting and completed-position cash balances
formulas.sampled_equity_drawdown: peak-to-trough of all observed held-position bar OPEN NAV and initial cash; neither ticks nor intrabar extremes
formulas.daily_cash_sharpe: mean(all UTC-calendar daily realized PnL / prior closed cash) / sample std * sqrt(365)
